items.title: DK Metcalf: Big volume in OT win
items.text:
Metcalf caught 11 of 15 targets for 93 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Ten touches in return to lineup
items.text:
Dowdle carried the ball seven times for 40 yards and caught three of four targets for nine yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Workload shrinks in Dowdle's return
items.text:
Warren carried the ball 14 times for 50 yards and caught two of four targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Leads comeback in OT win
items.text:
Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-19 overtime win over the Buccaneers.

items.title: Isaiah Likely: Another big day in Week 6 loss
items.text:
